summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights) now pass owner. One PR (#1) because the lib is inlined at build time and the changes must land together. Assumptions: owner values hardcoded to match each app's package.json 'team' (browser bundles can't read package.json); also fixed sub-route-reports, which wasn't in the sub-tasks but calls validateApp and would have broken. CI and CD green.
